name: pink-winged-fairy-clouds
image_vibe: Dreamy saturated pink fairy editorial with artificial clouds and theatrical wings
image_purpose: Create a fantasy fashion key visual for editorial, campaign, or moodboard use.

prompt.project_info: A full-body high-angle studio portrait of an adult woman seated among artificial pink clouds with large bright pink feathered wings.
prompt.main_subject: The adult woman from the required approved-adult face reference, preserving her face and facial structure. She has long straight dark hair and fair natural skin, with closed eyes and pink makeup including glitter eyeshadow and pink lipstick. She wears a pink mini dress or top, pink platform open-toe sandals with ankle straps, and a delicate necklace.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered high-angle full-body seated pose, large layered bright pink feathered wings visible behind the subject, artificial pink cloud platform and foreground, solid pink studio wall, and clean fantasy-fashion hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even studio lighting with pink ambient fill, saturated pink-dominant cinematic color treatment, dreamy theatrical fairy atmosphere, and controlled highlights on the wings, shoes, and jewelry.
prompt.technical_specs: Wide-lens high-angle composition, shallow depth of field focused on the woman and immediate surroundings, photorealistic fashion rendering, realistic feather/fabric/material texture, high-resolution clarity, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a full-body high-angle studio portrait of the adult woman from the required approved-adult face reference, preserving her face and facial structure. Seat her among artificial pink clouds with large layered bright pink feathered wings behind her. Give her long straight dark hair, fair natural skin, closed eyes, pink glitter eyeshadow, pink lipstick, and a delicate necklace. Dress her in a pink mini dress or top with pink platform open-toe sandals and ankle straps. Use a wide-lens high-angle centered composition, shallow depth of field focused on the subject and immediate surroundings, a solid pink studio wall, artificial pink cloud platform, soft even studio lighting with pink ambient fill, saturated pink-dominant cinematic grading, realistic feather and fabric texture, high-resolution fashion-editorial clarity, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, identity drift, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed wings, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text
